obligation: Carry exact V128 through the one shared VM and execute full-width vector load/store, logical/bitselect, shuffle/swizzle, splat and scalar lane extraction/replacement without a second vector executor or reference namespace.
representation: WasmType/WasmValue and ScalarBits own typed V128 transport. Constant::WasmV128 and Cell::WasmV128 store 16 little-endian bytes, avoiding u128 alignment in the shared heap/constant enums. Existing roots/cells/calls/globals/multi-result bundles and typed Host callbacks retain payloads. Constant pooling/keys, serialization, GC/metadata accounting and suite argument/result projections extend their existing authorities; vector NaN/lane matching reuses the shared scorer. Zero locals do not reuse incompatible Bits64 constants. A Rust macro owns each admitted SIMD operator, operand types, selector/lane domain and pure operation; lowering, runtime decoding, validation and disassembly derive from those facts. Bitselect composes admitted logical operations. Shuffles own a checked byte-index constant; malformed selectors/index arrays fail admission. Full-width V128 memory accesses reuse existing scalar load/store descriptors and checked Memory32/64 address/range operations. Residual format54 admits the new raw constant tag and shared SIMD opcodes; old formats are rejected.
scope: Previous 151-file resource/host/lifecycle ratchet plus every top-level pinned Wast source containing v128: 209 files. Exact matched input hashes/directive IDs and completed 60-second worker deadlines. Covers all admitted vector families and earlier Memory32/64, Table32/64, globals, imports and calls. No full suite, Test262, Node compat or benchmark run; this qualifies a SIMD port milestone, not complete Stage A or SIMD.

controls.obligations: Exact raw/tag-collision bits and function/global aliases, mixed-width zero locals, logical/bitselect/shuffle/swizzle, signed integer/NaN/signed-zero lane projections, Memory64 unaligned/vector boundary writes and trapping stores preserving prior bytes, large address traps, typed import mismatches.

checks.internal_obligations: Extended serialized multi-result root/GC/raw-bit ownership unit with V128 constants, residual roundtrip, guest calls and vector bundle payloads. Extended typed-host lease/native-guard unit with V128 input/results alongside reference leases and malformed callback recovery. Extended existing bytecode-domain unit with invalid selectors/shuffle arrays and valid controls, so rejection is not merely fall-through invalidity. No new ordinary conformance unit.

result.qualification: Exact shared-Wast modules: raw vector globals/function imports, logical/bitselect/shuffle/swizzle/lane rules, NaN/signed-zero payload projections, Memory64 unaligned/boundary vector accesses and write-before-trap state. JavaScript cannot directly pass/return V128; Wast controls and internal typed-callback/root/bundle checks own that qualification.

oracle.qualification_limit: Two exact shared-Wast modules agree on 12 scalar observations with local Node JITs disabled, including Memory64 vector effects/traps, raw NaN/signed-zero projections and V128 imports. JS cannot directly pass or return V128; Wast/internal controls qualify that typed boundary. SIMD arithmetic, extended vector loads and lane-memory operations remain unsupported and unqualified.

remaining: SIMD integer/float arithmetic, comparison, conversion and relaxed forms; extended/splat/zero/lane vector memory forms; concrete typed/GC/non-null references, shared resources/threads, remaining proposals, JS/Wasm adapters and embedding reentry. Three-suite qualification, implemented Node inventory/migration, production cutover and cleanup remain open. Stage A stays open; Stage B has not started.
